_about: Roadmap PHASE 0 golden benchmark (docs/LEGALMIND_RAG_PRODUCTION_ROADMAP.md §16-§17). Permanent, multi-source, category A-O. Every gold reference is a real ratified standard code, a Legal Constitution L1.10 section, or a statute section verified present in the supplied Acts on 2026-09-24 (rule 21: nothing authored). No document text, no counterparty name. Scored retrieval-side by tools/rag_benchmark.py with zero Gemini calls; the `answer` block is scored from PHASE 10 on.

refs.CONST:<section>: a Legal Constitution L1.10 section; no retrieval path exists at baseline (AM-43 r2)
refs.STAT:<Act title without 'The '>:<section: a statute section (Domain C); * = any section of that Act
refs.POS:*, STAT:*: in must_not only: ANY hit from that domain is a wrong source

gold_semantics: gold is a list of SLOTS; a slot is satisfied by any one of its refs. Multi-source completeness = every slot satisfied.
